scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config vite.console.ts && vite build --config vite.user.ts && vite build --config vite.account.ts && vite build --config vite.login.ts
scripts.wasm: cd .. && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -tags grpcnotrace -o ts/public/app.wasm ./wasm && cp "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" ts/public/
scripts.dev:sandbox: npm run wasm && VITE_SANDBOX=1 vite --config vite.console.ts
scripts.dev:user:sandbox: npm run wasm && VITE_SANDBOX=1 vite --config vite.user.ts --port 5176
